capturedIn: MCP Playwright (Chromium) against the live demo dev server at http://localhost:5173/navigation/dock — the demo's first story dock is a start-collapsed two-layer GlassDock (default slot + #collapsed), the slides config. The npm `playwright` harness is intentionally absent (glass-ui carries zero browser dependency), so the proof script SKIPs fail-open on a CI runner; these timelines are the behavioral witness captured in the wave's MCP env.

rootCauseCorrected.diagnosedInWaveSpec: useLayerTransition.ts natural-size measurement reading the collapsed summary floor as toSize (the measure-under-collapsed-class seam).
rootCauseCorrected.actualRootCause: `.glass-dock { container-type: inline-size }` (dock.css, AV.W16 TW3). `container-type: inline-size` applies `contain: inline-size`, making the element's inline size INDEPENDENT of its contents — fundamentally incompatible with a shrink-to-fit pill. EVERY horizontal dock (collapsed, expanded, AND always-expanded) collapsed to its ~19px padding floor with the active layer overflowing; the FLIP measured `.dock-layers` width as 0 and the morph short-circuited. The measurement seam the wave named was a symptom, not the cause: with the containment removed the stock `getSize` measures correctly and the morph runs unchanged.
rootCauseCorrected.fix: Remove the default `container: dock / inline-size` from `.glass-dock`; the `dock`-named container-query (the audacious-label narrow-box compression) becomes OPT-IN via the existing `containerName="dock"` prop (meaningful only where a consumer has width-constrained the dock into a host). The `width:100%`/`min-width:0` layers rules were never the problem — they were poisoned by the containment above them and resolve correctly once it is gone. ZERO change to useLayerTransition.ts.
rootCauseCorrected.waveFileBoundsNote: The wave spec forbade dock.css (scoping W1 to a useLayerTransition.ts measurement fix) and named the measurement seam as the cause. The empirical HEAD re-diagnosis (MCP Playwright) falsified that mechanism and localized the real cause to dock.css `container-type` — exactly the Triumvirate Dispatch re-plan trigger the wave names ('a different mechanism than diagnosed is a re-plan trigger'). The fix is the single correct root edit, not a workaround.

bornRed_3_3_0.description: HEAD (3.3.0) before the fix — the start-collapsed dock's first expand. Forced-FLIP path (startViewTransition removed). The `.dock-layers` width is frozen at 0 across all sampled frames; the dock box never grows past its ~19px collapsed floor.

alwaysExpandedAlsoBroken.note: Not just the collapse morph — every horizontal dock rendered as a ~19px sliver with content overflowing and no pill background. A far more pervasive regression than the wave's start-collapsed-first-expand framing.

green_postFix.description: After removing `container-type: inline-size` from `.glass-dock`. Stock useLayerTransition (reverted — no measurement change). Forced-FLIP path. The width morphs 40 -> 197 over a spring with the documented ~18.5% overshoot.
